en.headline: Housing Department says On Pak Court repairs are past 80 per cent
en.dek: The Anderson Road Home Ownership Scheme estate, the department's first modular project, is aiming to finish expanded paint work by mid-October.
body: The Housing Department says more than 80 per cent of external-wall repairs at On Pak Court in Anderson, Kwun Tong, are complete, and the contractor is aiming to finish before mid-October.

On Pak Court is the department's first Home Ownership Scheme project built with modular integrated construction. It was handed over in July 2025 and has 420 flats. Residents have reported blistering and peeling paint, white staining, a crack running from the 17th floor to the 14th, and leaking joints between modules.

The department said it ordered a full drone survey of the walls in early August. The survey found cracks, blisters and stains in the paint, which it attributed to workmanship: dust not fully cleaned in places before painting, or primer not applied evenly. Weather slowed the work, and the department widened the area of primer and topcoat repairs. It said drones would be used again after the work to check that it had been done properly.
Sing Tao reported that a visit on Tuesday found some of the earlier defects already patched, with workers painting from gondolas.

zh.headline: 房署指安柏苑外牆修繕已完成逾八成
zh.dek: 觀塘安達臣道居屋安柏苑是房屋署首個組裝合成居屋項目，署方稱承建商正爭取10月中旬前完成已擴大範圍的油漆修繕。
body: 房屋署表示，觀塘安達臣道安柏苑外牆修繕已完成超過八成，承建商正爭取於10月中旬前全部完成。
安柏苑是房屋署首個以組裝合成建築法興建的居者有其屋計劃項目，2025年7月交樓，共420伙。業主反映外牆起泡、甩漆、泛白華，有裂痕由17樓垂直伸至14樓，組裝模組接駁位亦出現收縮開裂及滲漏。
署方說，8月上旬已責成承建商以無人機全面勘察外牆。勘察發現油漆多處裂紋、起泡及污漬，估計是局部位置上油前未徹底清理灰塵，或封底漆未均勻塗上，屬油漆施工工藝欠妥。修繕受天氣影響，署方並主動擴大執修底油及面油的範圍。署方表示，修繕完成後會再用無人機核實工程是否妥善。
《星島頭條》報道，周二到場視察，部分早前問題已修補，並見工人在吊船進行髤油。
